name: 3REN Berhad
overview: 2026年公司公告主要为股份拆细/附加上市、董事会委员会人事变动、股息除权及季度业绩发布，未见涉及业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售、或取得合约的公告。
overview_en: In 2026, the company's announcements mainly covered additional listing/subdivision of shares, changes in board committees, dividend ex-date, and quarterly results. No announcements related to business segment expansion, new businesses, downsizing or divestment, or contract wins were observed.
